answer: A farm of 246 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in cipher, queued in dawn, and ember publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 11 identities per epoch. A farm of 3936 identities would post 907 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
